title: Identify the Form
text:
The equation $y = 3x - 2$ is in the form $y = mx + c$ where:
- $m$ is the gradient
- $c$ is the y-intercept

title: Extract the Gradient
text:
Comparing $y = 3x - 2$ with $y = mx + c$:

The coefficient of $x$ is $3$, so $m = 3$.

title: Apply Parallel Line Property
text:
Parallel lines have equal gradients.

Since the original line has $m = 3$, the parallel line also has gradient $m = 3$.
